Hello fellow learners...!!!

I would like to share my experience after completing the course and strongly recommend Edwin Art of Driving School for the following reasons

1. The training program is well-organized and pays attention to minute details of driving techniques.

2.Edwin classes and techniques are  significantly more effective than conventional motor driving schools, which often waste your time and money.

3.The course includes a theoretical framework explaining how a car responds in different situations before practical lessons begin.

4.Edwin team including his trainers are highly educated and skilled individuals who understand the emotional challenges faced by beginner drivers. They focus on addressing each learner's specific weaknesses and pain areas.

5. Edwin himself came to my first class upon my request despite his busy schedule, which demonstrated his commitment to the students.

6.From my first lesson on clutch control, I felt empowered and in command of the vehicle, significantly boosting my confidence.

7.The training also covers defensive driving techniques that are not commonly taught in India, helping me better understand other drivers' behaviors on the road.

8.The ability to schedule classes according to individual needs was an added benefit for me. I give this aspect a perfect score of 5/5 for their understanding and flexibility.

After completing the course, I have gained a level of confidence that I did not achieve through traditional motor driving classes. The premium fee charged is absolutely justified by the quality of training provided.

Thank you to Edwin and his team!
Wishing best of luck for his future endeavours.

featured_reviews.name: Srikanth “Loy” Ayithy
featured_reviews.review_text:
I applied recently for Two wheeler and Four wheeler license. Also, I want to learn four wheeler. Their standard course is for 21 days.

You can select the vehicle you want to learn. By default, they will teach in santro. If you want to learn in Honda City, a little additional to be paid.  They also arrange classes using your own vehicle. I was taught by Anil.

When I went for payment on day 1, there and then, they asked my address proof and Id proof. Using that they filled the application. They scheduled a test in next hour. They asked me to go to nearest RTO to give application and take test.    I went to RTO, there are three steps.

1. There will be bio metric. They will take finger prints and Photo.
2. Wait for the token number, go to that police counter. They will verify your application and proofs and they also check your physical if there are any deformations. Once done they will send to  room for test.
3. It's a test for 15 marks. You need 8 to pass the test. Once passed, you were asked to wait, they will give to two laminated learners licence ID cards.

Using that I have been learning driving using Honda City taught by Anil who is very patient and very good tutor.  Overall, i had a good experience so far. i will update this comment once main lisence test is done get my lisence.

featured_reviews.name: New Babubhai mts

featured_reviews.name: Hitesh Kirtane
featured_reviews.review_text:
At this driving school, the instructors exploit the situation by requesting additional funds under the pretenses of "Gurudakshina" and "Chai Pani." Even after having paid the complete course fee, an extra 1000 - 2000 rupees is sought without a clear rationale. Regrettably, proper instruction is withheld unless compliance with these unjustifiable requests is met. To provide an illustration, my four-wheeler driving course wound up costing over 7000 rupees in 2022, inclusive of these questionable charges.

On the other hand, the disrespectful behavior is exhibited by both the instructors and the management, creating an unpleasant atmosphere for students.

If you don't possess a vehicle, your learning experience is adversely impacted. Instruction is limited to a brief 30-minute session per day, excluding Sundays, which proves inadequate for instilling confidence in your driving abilities. Additionally, in the event of instructor absence, no replacements are arranged, resulting in lengthy breaks in your learning process, disrupting the flow of your education.

Post-training, the scheduling of the final driving test is significantly delayed, often taking two months or more. The explanation provided is the protracted RTO processes, but this reasoning lacks justification. This delay can pose a challenge, especially if you lack a personal vehicle for additional practice. The gap before the test might induce nervousness, leading to errors during the exam due to a lack of recent practice.

I'm sharing this comprehensive account to ensure individuals are informed about the situation at this driving school. It is crucial for prospective students to have this knowledge before making a decision to enroll.

featured_reviews.name: Siddhesh Gholap
featured_reviews.review_text:
Overall Excellent experience with Mahalakshmi Motor Training School...
Helped a lot from day 1 till day of getting Permanent Driving Licence in hand .
Special Thanks to Manish sir & Pankaj sir , the way he taught was great.
Appreciate the same!

featured_reviews.name: Chetan Prabhu
featured_reviews.review_text:
We are truly grateful to Manish bhai and his motor training school for making our daughter's driving journey such a smooth and stress-free experience! 🙏🏻🚗

Manish bhai guided her with immense patience, professionalism, and care. The entire process — from training to documentation — was handled so seamlessly that we didn't have to worry about a thing.

featured_reviews.name: Sneak Out Tours
featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent experience in getting my first 4 Wheeler Driving Licence at the age of 18 years to adding the 2 wheeler Driving Licence years later especially for my Goa and Ladakh Trip to now getting my International Driving Licence (IDP) to drive in 150 other countries of the World. I have driven in all terrain during my road trips be it the Mumbai Traffic, to High Altitude Mountains roads, to off roading tracks in remote villages, to Snow covered lanes of the north and now in many international countries I owe my driving skills to Manish Sir of Mahalaxmi Motor Training School. The process is smooth and the learnings are for a lifetime. He proved it Girls can drive !!!

featured_reviews.name: Aakash Dutt
featured_reviews.review_text: All the queries related to international drivers permit were addressed in detail and in a polite manner over call. All documentation done by Mr. Manish itself, I just had to be present for signing  of permit at RTO. All procedures carried out swiftly without any obstruction and bare minimum contact. All in all, if you want to get your job done without any hassle, this is the place to go.

featured_reviews.name: kavi Prashil
featured_reviews.review_text:
Manish ji is very professional and committed towards the work, really will recommend him only for Rto related stuff to my friends and family.
Thank you again.

featured_reviews.name: Sherrin Joseph
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a great experience with Mahalakshmi motor training school. Manish sir is very professional and knowledgeable about the entire RTO process. The training phase and the license procurement phase were both hassle free and quick.

featured_reviews.name: Aaditya Karekar
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a great experience with Mahalaxmi Motor Training School. I took services for both two-wheeler and four-wheeler licenses, along with 20 days of car training. Manish ji was extremely supportive, patient, and professional throughout the process. The best part is how stress-free the entire experience was — whether it was the learning test or the actual driving exam, everything was smooth and well-managed. You really feel confident that you're getting your license without any hassle. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Durwin Menezes
featured_reviews.review_text: I am highly satisfied with the training provided. The instructors demonstrated considerable expertise, offering clear and comprehensive guidance. My driving skills have improved significantly. 🚗💨👍.

featured_reviews.name: Malcolm Mascarenhas
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a memorable experience learning driving here. Mohammad Ali sir is a humble and excellent instructor, who made driving even more fun, challenging and enjoyable for me. I chose their newest Brezza, and the experience of learning on an SUV was even more exciting.

I highly recommend Ravi Maruti Driving School.
Their representatives were very helpful and quick to respond to any query. Their car fleet is the best among other local driving classes. And their learning plans are thoughtfully designed to help you confidently drive your own car right after the course.

Thank you Ali bhai, for all your guidance and support.

featured_reviews.name: Sagar Tambe
featured_reviews.review_text:
Great experience with this driving course.
The simulator is very realistic and helped me get over my initial nerves.
My instructor, Mohammad, was excellent—very calm and professional. He made sure I was prepared for all kinds of driving situations.
10/10 recommend!

featured_reviews.name: RAVINDRA PATIL
featured_reviews.review_text:
This driving school is truly excellent. I completed my training within 15 days, and Mohamad Sir and Suresh sir was assigned as my instructor. He is a very skilled trainer, supportive, and patient. He pointed out all my mistakes and helped me improve my driving skills step by step. I sincerely appreciate his guidance and support.

Initially, I was planning to join Praveen Driving Classes, but they train multiple students at the same time. I also believe they do not have a simulator machine, which is very helpful for improving judgement and confidence. However, Maruti Suzuki Driving School provides training to one student at a time, which makes a big difference in learning effectively. This personalized attention is the most important reason I chose this driving school.

Overall, it was a great learning experience, and I highly recommend it to anyone who wants to learn driving properly and confidently.

featured_reviews.name: Aryan Parab
featured_reviews.review_text:
Amazing experience! The confidence I gained here was truly next level, all thanks to having such a great instructor. Ali Sir played a huge role in helping me feel comfortable and confident while driving on the road. His knowledge is exceptional, and his guidance makes you feel safe at all times.
The training program is very well-structured, covering everything from highways and local roads to parking and reverse driving. The cars provided are also in excellent condition, which adds to the overall experience.
Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Shivangee Lahiri
featured_reviews.review_text: Great experience with Maruti Driving School Ghatkopar.I was really struggling with confidence, but my instructor taught me to trust my instincts in simple, easy-to-follow steps that finally clicked. They don't just teach you how to pass the test; they teach you how to be a safe, confident driver for life. Definitely worth the investment! Thank you Muhammad bhai.

featured_reviews.name: Nirmay More
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very good experience learning driving at Maruti Suzuki Driving School. The training was professional, well-structured, and very comfortable for beginners.

A special thanks to Sir Mohammad Ali for his excellent guidance and patience. He explained every rule and technique clearly, corrected my mistakes calmly, and helped me build confidence on the road.

featured_reviews.name: Nishita Surin
featured_reviews.review_text:
Excellent experience. Classes are well organized and very systematic. Mohammed is a great instructor. Really takes the time to teach oneself properly.
Highly recommend.

featured_reviews.name: Karthik Nadar
featured_reviews.review_text: Loved both the simulator and the on-road driving experience. Felt a little confident coming from the simulator to the actual car. Makes real sense. Also, I have always read reviews about not so pleasant experiences with the instructors, but here, the instructors were calm and gave relevant information about driving and the road awareness. Even the ma'am on the helpdesk was always calm, and she helped me schedule the training schedules based on my availability and in fact adjusted whenever I wasn't able to make it.
